examConfig.title: CS3401 - Web Technologies Mid-Semester Online Examination
instructions: Each question carries equal marks (1 mark each).
No negative marking for incorrect answers.
The examination will submit automatically once the countdown timer reaches 00:00.
Use the Question Palette on the right to navigate directly to any question.
You can mark questions for review and return to them prior to final submission.

questions.explanation: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language, the standard markup language for creating web documents.

questions.text: Which CSS property is used to control the spacing between adjacent elements outside the border?
questions.explanation: Margin creates space around an element's border, whereas padding creates space inside the border.

questions.text: Which JavaScript method is used to attach an event handler to a DOM element without overwriting existing event handlers?
questions.explanation: addEventListener() adds an event listener to a target DOM node without overwriting any previous listeners.

questions.text: In JavaScript, what will the expression `typeof null` evaluate to?
questions.explanation: Due to a historic bug in the original JavaScript implementation preserved for backward compatibility, typeof null returns 'object'.

questions.text: Which HTML5 semantic element represents an independent, self-contained piece of content that could be distributed on its own?
questions.explanation: The <article> tag specifies independent, self-contained content such as blog posts or news articles.

questions.text: What does JSON stand for in web application development?
questions.explanation: JSON stands for JavaScript Object Notation, a lightweight data-interchange text format.

questions.text: Which Web Storage mechanism stores data with NO expiration date across browser sessions?
questions.explanation: localStorage stores data persistently until explicitly cleared by the user or code.

questions.text: Which HTTP status code indicates a successful resource creation on the server?
questions.explanation: HTTP status 201 Created indicates that the request has succeeded and led to the creation of a resource.
